literal.prompt: Какой шельфовый ледник расположен у южной оконечности моря Уэдделла?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BAS L152 directly puts Ronne/Filchner Ice Shelf at southern end of Weddell Sea. This is the actual narrowed predicate; it asserts no percentage/majority area. NSIDC L78 places Larsen along eastern Peninsula, AAP L316-L317 and NASA Amery L267 place Amery at East Antarctica/Prydz, and NASA Getz L261-L268 places Getz at Marie Byrd Land. All four labels are real shelves but only Filchner–Ronne matches the southern-Weddell end.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Ларсена тянется вдоль восточного берега Антарктического полуострова.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NSIDC L78 explicitly locates Larsen along eastern Antarctic Peninsula; L81-L82 describes remaining sections and some already disintegrated. Present tense describes the system without claiming all its pre-collapse area remains or that A/B returned. This is the actual Larsen note, not a Filchner–Ronne fact.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Эймери расположен в заливе Прюдс в Восточной Антарктиде.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AAP L316 gives East Antarctic embayed Amery and L317 describes its ice front discharging directly into Prydz Bay; the note’s bay location follows the front-to-bay relationship. NASA Amery L267 independently confirms East Antarctica. The note does not say all the bay is ice-filled or make a current calving prediction.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Гетца тянется вдоль побережья Земли Мэри Бэрд.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NASA Getz article L261-L268 places the full Getz margin along Marie Byrd Land’s West Antarctic coastal sector. The note uses only that physical coast location; no extrapolation of historical retreat rate or division by islands is used.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: На восточной стороне части Ронне расположен покрытый льдом остров Беркнер.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BAS L142 explicitly says Berkner lies on eastern side of Ronne and is an ice-covered island with two domes. The note retains east-Ronne/island/ice-covered facts, not unsupported Filchner–Ronne partition. It adds a named local landmark relationship beyond the whole southern-Weddell prompt/key, even though part of the same fact is also allowed in explanation.
